who.en:
Figo is the box for an adult with chronic kidney disease, in two forms: kidney disease not yet on dialysis, and life on haemodialysis. Community studies estimate that 7–14% of Tanzanian adults have chronic kidney disease, most often caused by high blood pressure and diabetes, and most do not know it until the kidneys are failing. Tanzania has about 47 haemodialysis units caring for some 3,231 people, at USD 80–120 a session (Kidney360 2024, as cited earlier; not re-opened), so every year that dialysis is delayed matters to the whole family.

Before dialysis, KDIGO 2024 shows that loss of kidney function can be slowed: blood pressure kept at the clinic’s target, salt under 5 g a day, kidney-harming painkillers such as ibuprofen and diclofenac avoided, and every prescribed medicine taken exactly. The first box brings a validated blood-pressure monitor, a scale for daily weight, a kidney logbook, a pill box and measuring spoons; each 3-month box brings batteries, salt-free seasoning, a moisturiser and mild soap for dry, itchy skin, water treatment against diarrhoea, and toothpaste.

On haemodialysis the body cannot remove water or salt between sessions, so thirst, weight gain, itch and the care of the fistula are the daily work. The first box brings a scale, a measuring jug for the fluid allowance, a monitor for the arm without the fistula, a thermometer, a logbook and a pill box; each 2-month box brings mild soap for the fistula arm, sterile gauze for needle sites, hand sanitiser, sugar-free gum and an alcohol-free rinse for thirst, moisturiser, lip balm and toothpaste.

The fluid limit and the diet, including potassium, phosphate and protein, are set by the renal clinic and its dietitian, never by the box. Dialysis consumables that are prescription items or medical devices used by the unit (dialysers, bloodlines, fistula needles, dialysis fluid, heparin, anaemia injections, catheter dressings) are supplied by the dialysis unit, and tablets by the licensed partner pharmacy. Afya sells only the non-prescription goods in this box.
who.sw:
Figo ni sanduku la mtu mzima mwenye ugonjwa sugu wa figo, kwa namna mbili: ugonjwa wa figo kabla ya dialisisi, na maisha kwenye dialisisi ya damu. Tafiti za jamii zinakadiria kwamba asilimia 7–14 ya watu wazima Tanzania wana ugonjwa sugu wa figo, mara nyingi unaosababishwa na presha na kisukari, na wengi hawajui hadi figo zinaposhindwa. Tanzania ina takriban vituo 47 vya dialisisi vinavyohudumia watu wapatao 3,231, kwa dola 80–120 za Marekani kwa kipindi kimoja, hivyo kila mwaka ambao dialisisi inacheleweshwa ni muhimu kwa familia nzima.

Kabla ya dialisisi, KDIGO 2024 inaonyesha kwamba kupungua kwa kazi ya figo kunaweza kupunguzwa kasi: presha ikiwa kwenye lengo la kliniki, chumvi chini ya gramu 5 kwa siku, kuepuka dawa za maumivu zinazodhuru figo kama ibuprofen na diclofenac, na kumeza kila dawa iliyoandikwa sawasawa. Sanduku la kwanza huleta kipimo cha presha kilichothibitishwa, mizani ya kupima uzito kila siku, daftari la figo, kisanduku cha vidonge na vijiko vya kupimia; kila sanduku la miezi 3 huleta betri, viungo visivyo na chumvi, losheni na sabuni laini kwa ngozi kavu inayowasha, dawa ya kutibu maji dhidi ya kuharisha, na dawa ya meno.

Kwenye dialisisi mwili hauwezi kutoa maji wala chumvi kati ya vipindi, hivyo kiu, uzito kuongezeka, muwasho na utunzaji wa fistula ndiyo kazi ya kila siku. Sanduku la kwanza huleta mizani, jagi la kupimia kiasi cha maji, kipimo cha presha kwa mkono usio na fistula, kipimajoto, daftari na kisanduku cha vidonge; kila sanduku la miezi 2 huleta sabuni laini kwa mkono wa fistula, shashi safi kwa sehemu za sindano, kitakasa mikono, ubani usio na sukari na dawa ya kusukutua isiyo na alkoholi kwa kiu, losheni, mafuta ya midomo na dawa ya meno.

Kiasi cha maji na lishe, ikiwemo potasiamu, fosfeti na protini, huwekwa na kliniki ya figo na mtaalamu wake wa lishe, kamwe si na sanduku. Vifaa vya dialisisi ambavyo ni vya kuandikiwa au vifaa tiba vinavyotumiwa na kituo (vichujio, mirija ya damu, sindano za fistula, maji ya dialisisi, heparini, sindano za upungufu wa damu, vifuniko vya katheta) hutolewa na kituo cha dialisisi, na vidonge na famasia mshirika yenye leseni. Afya inauza tu bidhaa zisizohitaji cheti cha daktari zilizo kwenye sanduku hili.

clinic_line.en: Your fluid limit, your diet (salt, potassium, phosphate and protein), your blood pressure target, your medicines and doses, and how often you are tested are decided by your renal clinic or dialysis unit. Afya does not sell medicines or dialysis supplies: the licensed partner pharmacy supplies tablets on prescription, and the unit supplies what is used in each session. Fever of 38 °C or more, a fistula that stops buzzing, bleeding that does not stop, or sudden breathlessness needs the unit the same day.
clinic_line.sw: Kiasi chako cha maji, lishe yako (chumvi, potasiamu, fosfeti na protini), lengo la presha, dawa na dozi zake, na mara ngapi upimwe huamuliwa na kliniki yako ya figo au kituo cha dialisisi. Afya haiuzi dawa wala vifaa vya dialisisi: famasia mshirika yenye leseni hutoa vidonge kwa maelekezo ya daktari, na kituo hutoa vinavyotumika kila kipindi. Homa ya nyuzi 38 au zaidi, fistula iliyoacha kutetemeka, damu isiyokoma, au kubanwa pumzi ghafla vinahitaji kituo siku hiyo hiyo.

name.sw: Kipimo cha presha cha mkono wa juu kilichothibitishwa

why.en: Blood pressure control is the strongest tool for slowing kidney disease (KDIGO 2024, as cited earlier; not re-opened). Your renal clinic sets your target. A validated upper-arm monitor gives readings the clinic can trust; wrist devices are left out. Measure seated after five minutes’ rest, twice morning and evening for a week before each review. If you have, or are being prepared for, a fistula, never measure on that arm.
why.sw: Kudhibiti presha ndiyo nyenzo yenye nguvu zaidi ya kupunguza kasi ya ugonjwa wa figo (KDIGO 2024). Kliniki yako ya figo huweka lengo lako. Kipimo cha mkono wa juu kilichothibitishwa hutoa vipimo ambavyo kliniki inaviamini; vipimo vya kifundo cha mkono vimeachwa. Pima ukiwa umekaa baada ya kupumzika dakika tano, mara mbili asubuhi na jioni kwa wiki moja kabla ya kila ziara. Ikiwa una fistula, au unaandaliwa kupata, usipime kamwe kwenye mkono huo.

name.sw: Mizani ya kupimia uzito

why.en: In kidney disease a gain of 1–2 kg over a few days usually means retained fluid, not fat, and is often the first sign of swelling or breathlessness. Weighing every morning after the toilet and before breakfast makes that visible early; tell the clinic when the weight rises quickly. Body-fat readings on some scales are not reliable with kidney disease; the weight is what counts.
why.sw: Katika ugonjwa wa figo, kuongezeka kilo 1–2 ndani ya siku chache kwa kawaida ni maji yaliyobaki mwilini, si mafuta, na mara nyingi ni dalili ya kwanza ya kuvimba au kubanwa pumzi. Kujipima kila asubuhi baada ya choo na kabla ya kifungua kinywa huonyesha hili mapema; iambie kliniki uzito ukipanda haraka. Vipimo vya mafuta mwilini kwenye baadhi ya mizani si sahihi kwa wenye ugonjwa wa figo; uzito ndio muhimu.

why.en: One book holding blood pressure, morning weight, laboratory results and every medicine, including anything bought over the counter, lets the renal clinic see trends and spot drugs that harm the kidneys, such as ibuprofen and diclofenac. why.en: WHO HEARTS names daily adherence as the weak link: blood pressure rises again within days of stopping tablets, and most people need two or more medicines. name.sw: Vijiko vya kupimia chumvi

why.en: KDIGO 2024 advises less than 2 g of sodium a day for most people with kidney disease, which is under 5 g of salt, the same limit WHO sets for all adults (WHO salt fact sheet, opened 10 Nov 2026). Measuring the salt for the family pot with a spoon set, instead of pouring by hand, is the simplest way to reach it. Your renal clinic may set a different limit.

name.sw: Viungo visivyo na chumvi (kitunguu saumu, tangawizi, pilipili manga au manjano)

why.en: Herbs and spices keep low-salt food enjoyable so the change lasts; garlic, ginger, pepper and turmeric are low in sodium, and in normal cooking amounts add little potassium. Stock cubes and seasoning salts are left out. Potassium “low-sodium” salt substitutes are never sent: WHO’s 2025 guideline on salt substitutes excludes people with kidney impairment, because potassium can build up to dangerous levels (search summary; the guideline itself was not opened). How much potassium, phosphate and protein you eat is set by your renal clinic or dietitian.
why.sw: Viungo huifanya chakula chenye chumvi kidogo kiwe kitamu ili mabadiliko yadumu; kitunguu saumu, tangawizi, pilipili manga na manjano vina sodiamu kidogo, na kwa kiasi cha kawaida cha kupikia huongeza potasiamu kidogo tu. Vidonge vya supu na chumvi za viungo vimeachwa. Chumvi mbadala zenye potasiamu hazitumwi kamwe: mwongozo wa WHO wa 2025 kuhusu chumvi mbadala hauwahusu wenye matatizo ya figo, kwa sababu potasiamu inaweza kujilimbikiza hadi kiwango cha hatari. Kiasi cha potasiamu, fosfeti na protini unachokula huamuliwa na kliniki yako ya figo au mtaalamu wa lishe.

name.en: Body moisturiser for dry, itchy skin
name.sw: Losheni ya mwili kwa ngozi kavu inayowasha

why.en: Dry, itchy skin is common as kidney function falls and waste builds up in the blood; a 2023 systematic review found regular emollients the first and safest step (as cited earlier; not re-opened). Covering the whole body once a day after bathing uses about 12–15 ml. Itch that keeps you awake is worth telling the clinic about: it can mean phosphate or dialysis needs adjusting.
why.sw: Ngozi kavu inayowasha ni ya kawaida figo zinapopungua kufanya kazi na uchafu kujilimbikiza kwenye damu; mapitio ya tafiti ya 2023 yalikuta kupaka mafuta mara kwa mara ndiyo hatua ya kwanza na salama zaidi. Kupaka mwili mzima mara moja kwa siku baada ya kuoga hutumia takriban ml 12–15. Muwasho unaokukosesha usingizi uiambie kliniki: unaweza kumaanisha fosfeti au dialisisi inahitaji kurekebishwa.

name.sw: Sabuni laini kwa ngozi kavu

why.en: Strong antiseptic and perfumed soaps strip oil from skin that is already dry and itchy. A mild, creamy bar used once a day keeps the skin clean without cracking it. Kidney disease weakens immunity, so washing hands with soap before meals and after the toilet is also the simplest protection against infection.

name.sw: Dawa ya kutibu maji ya kunywa

why.en: An episode of diarrhoea is one of the commonest causes of a sudden, sometimes permanent, fall in kidney function, and Tanzania’s cholera outbreaks have been traced to untreated stored water. Chlorinating household water reduces diarrhoea (Cochrane 2015, as cited earlier; not re-opened). Boiling is a good alternative where fuel allows.
why.sw: Kuharisha ni mojawapo ya sababu za kawaida za figo kushuka ghafla, wakati mwingine kwa kudumu, na milipuko ya kipindupindu Tanzania imehusishwa na maji yaliyohifadhiwa bila kutibiwa. Kuweka klorini kwenye maji ya nyumbani hupunguza kuharisha (Cochrane 2015). Kuchemsha ni njia nzuri pia pale nishati inaporuhusu.

why.en: Herbs and spices keep low-salt food enjoyable so the change lasts; garlic, ginger, pepper and turmeric are low in sodium, and in normal cooking amounts add little potassium. Stock cubes and seasoning salts are left out. Potassium “low-sodium” salt substitutes are never sent: WHO’s 2025 guideline on salt substitutes excludes people with kidney impairment, because potassium can build up to dangerous levels (search summary; the guideline itself was not opened). why.en: An episode of diarrhoea is one of the commonest causes of a sudden, sometimes permanent, fall in kidney function, and Tanzania’s cholera outbreaks have been traced to untreated stored water. Chlorinating household water reduces diarrhoea (Cochrane 2015, as cited earlier; not re-opened). Boiling is a good alternative where fuel allows.

Kuweka klorini kwenye maji ya nyumbani hupunguza kuharisha (Cochrane 2015). Kuchemsha ni njia nzuri pia pale nishati inaporuhusu.

name.sw: Mizani ya kupimia uzito

why.en: On dialysis, weight gained between sessions is water: one kilogram is about one litre the next session must remove. Large gains cause cramps and low blood pressure on the machine and strain the heart over time. How much gain is allowed is set by your dialysis unit. Weighing each morning lets you see the gain building and drink less before it is too late.

name.en: Measuring jug for the daily fluid allowance

why.en: On haemodialysis the kidneys no longer remove water, so the renal clinic sets a daily fluid allowance; it is often a set amount plus the previous day’s urine, but the number is the unit’s decision, not the box’s. It is the most practical habit for keeping weight gain between sessions within the unit’s range.
why.sw: Kwenye dialisisi figo hazitoi tena maji, hivyo kliniki ya figo huweka kiasi cha maji cha kila siku; mara nyingi ni kiasi maalum pamoja na mkojo wa jana, lakini namba ni uamuzi wa kituo, si wa sanduku. name.en: Mild soap for the fistula arm

why.en: KDOQI 2019 asks people on haemodialysis to wash the access arm with soap and water every day and just before each session, because skin bacteria carried in by the needles cause most access infections (as cited earlier; not re-opened). name.en: Sterile gauze swabs for needle sites
name.sw: Shashi safi kwa sehemu za sindano

why.en: Needle sites can start bleeding again at home hours after a session. The right response is firm, steady pressure with clean gauze for about ten minutes, never a tight bandage around the arm, which can clot the fistula. Bleeding that does not stop needs the unit at once. Sterile gauze is a non-prescription medical device; the needles, lines and dressings used during the session are supplied by the unit.
why.sw: Sehemu za sindano zinaweza kuanza kutoa damu tena nyumbani saa kadhaa baada ya kipindi. Jibu sahihi ni kubana kwa nguvu na kwa utulivu kwa shashi safi kwa takriban dakika kumi, kamwe si kufunga bandeji kwa nguvu kuzunguka mkono, kwani inaweza kuziba fistula. Damu isiyokoma inahitaji kituo mara moja. Shashi safi ni kifaa tiba kisichohitaji cheti cha daktari; sindano, mirija na vifuniko vinavyotumika wakati wa kipindi hutolewa na kituo.

why.en: Thirst and a dry mouth make the fluid allowance hard to keep. services_note.en: Monthly in-store check (blood pressure on the non-fistula arm, weight, medicine list review for kidney-harming drugs): free, a store service. A kidney profile every 3 months (not on dialysis) and serum albumin every 3 months (on dialysis) through a partner laboratory are add-ons, charged in the month they are done, unless the renal clinic already does them; AfyaDepot’s walk-in prices are TSh 55,000 and TSh 12,000 (opened 10 Nov 2026, market reference only). Fistula checks happen at the dialysis unit at every session.
services_note.sw: Ukaguzi wa kila mwezi dukani (presha kwenye mkono usio na fistula, uzito, kupitia orodha ya dawa kutafuta zinazodhuru figo): bure, ni huduma ya duka. Kipimo cha figo kila miezi 3 (bila dialisisi) na albumini ya damu kila miezi 3 (kwenye dialisisi) kupitia maabara mshirika ni huduma za ziada, hulipiwa mwezi zinapofanyika, isipokuwa kliniki ya figo tayari inazifanya; bei za AfyaDepot kwa mteja wa kawaida ni TSh 55,000 na TSh 12,000 (kumbukumbu ya soko tu). Ukaguzi wa fistula hufanyika kituoni kila kipindi.
